raw_segments.text: When the sessions came round, Mr. Jaggers caused an application to be made for the postponement
of his trial until the following sessions.
It was obviously made with the assurance that he could not live so long and was refused.
The trial came on at once, and when he was put to the bar, he was seated in a chair.
No objection was made to my getting close to the dock, on the outside of it, and holding
the hand that he stretched forth to me.
